description: Ponctualité des trains Eurostar - Continental Route - Stiptheid van Eurostar - Continental Route treinen - Monthly Eurostar - Continental Route trains punctuality is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly punctuality of Eurostar - Continental Route (formerly Thalys) trains on the Infrabel network. From October 1st 2023, the Thalys brand will be replaced by the Eurostar brand. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-03-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
